rules.name: Proactive Risk Alert Triggering
rules.statement: The system must generate a proactive risk alert when correlated data indicates a high probability of SLA breach or inventory error within the defined prediction window.
rules.condition: when predictive analytics correlate delivery delays, inventory errors, and customer sentiment to indicate imminent brand or SLA risk
exceptions: when the risk probability falls below the configured threshold
rules.if_violated: the system fails to notify stakeholders of impending operational failures, leading to unmitigated reputational damage and potential order loss
rules.rationale: shifting from reactive to proactive management prevents brand equity erosion before customer dissatisfaction becomes irreversible

parameters.name: prediction_window
parameters.description: time horizon in minutes for forecasting risk events

parameters.name: risk_threshold
parameters.description: minimum probability score required to trigger an alert

rules.name: High-Velocity Inventory Safety Margin
rules.statement: The system must only flag a synchronization discrepancy for high-velocity items when the projected demand exceeds current inventory by the defined safety margin.
rules.condition: when calculating inventory availability for high-velocity products against projected demand
exceptions: for items explicitly marked as 'non-critical' in the product catalog
rules.if_violated: the system may oversell critical stock or fail to alert on genuine shortages, causing order cancellations and customer churn
rules.rationale: focusing alerts on high-velocity items ensures resources are directed toward preventing the most impactful stockouts

parameters.name: safety_margin
parameters.description: percentage buffer required between projected demand and available stock

rules.name: SLA Breach Notification Deduplication
rules.statement: The system must only send a notification regarding a status change if the new status differs from the status of the most recent notification for that specific transaction.
rules.condition: when processing a status update for an order or refund request
exceptions: when the notification channel has been explicitly overridden by a supervisor
rules.if_violated: the customer receives redundant or conflicting messages, causing confusion and eroding trust in the platform's communication reliability
rules.rationale: ensures clear, non-repetitive communication to maintain a professional customer experience

parameters.name: notification_frequency_limit
parameters.description: maximum number of status updates allowed per transaction cycle

rules.name: Refund Status Content Integrity
rules.statement: The system must verify that the content of any notification accurately reflects the current state of the Financial Transaction Record before transmission.
rules.condition: when composing a notification message triggered by a refund status change
exceptions: during system rollback procedures initiated by engineering
when the Financial Transaction Record is temporarily locked for audit
rules.if_violated: the customer receives incorrect financial information, leading to disputes, chargebacks, and regulatory compliance issues
rules.rationale: financial accuracy in communications is non-negotiable to prevent disputes and maintain regulatory adherence

parameters.name: validation_latency
parameters.description: maximum time allowed to fetch the latest financial record before sending
